comparison.objective: Extract one panel from a leaning rack while moving only necessary blockers; not commission damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential panel support, constrained extraction, and upright placement versus small-tool alignment, adjustment, locking, and physical response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Target on inspection plate, moved blockers on mat, no panel beyond 10° tilt versus bounded impact travel, rebound, overload, and setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both penalize unsafe handling, but the manipulation and measured outcomes differ. No separate specs were present.
